description: This file provides utility classes, functions, and mock implementations for testing URLRequest components in the Chromium networking codebase. It includes classes for creating test URLRequest contexts, delegates, network delegates, and interceptors, as well as related helper functions.

classes.name: TestURLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Provides a dummy URLRequestContext for testing, living on a specified message loop.

classes.name: TestDelegate
classes.description: Implements URLRequest::Delegate for testing, capturing request events and states.

classes.name: TestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: A mock network delegate for testing network request behaviors and callbacks.

classes.name: FilteringTestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: A specialized network delegate that can filter cookies and modify request behavior for testing.

classes.name: HttpTestServer
classes.description: A simple embedded test server with default handlers for testing HTTP requests.

classes.name: TestScopedURLInterceptor
classes.description: Sets up a URLRequestInterceptor for intercepting specific URL requests during tests.

methods.name: CreateTestURLRequestContextBuilder
methods.description: Creates and configures a URLRequestContextBuilder for testing purposes.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext associated with this getter.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner for network operations.
